# do_EnrichmentHeatmap() | Gene set enrichment

```{r}
#| results: "asis"
#| echo: false
source("../_common.R")
```

Enrichment heatmaps visualize gene set enrichment scores across cells or groups.

## Basic usage

```{r}
#| eval: false
p <- SCpubr::do_EnrichmentHeatmap(sample = sample,
                                  input_gene_list = gene_sets)
p
```
